description: A bearded man in dark, worn clothing stands bound with his wrists behind him, chained to a wooden post, with a bundle of books tied against his waist. A pile of logs with green leaves burns around his feet, with smoke and flames rising. Around him stand a crowd in early-modern dress: helmeted soldiers with armour on the left, women in white headcloths, and men in black hats and long dark cloaks on the right. A stone castle sits on a distant hill under an overcast sky. No visible text, frame or wounds.
